answer_1.quote: As one of the major natural language generation tasks, automatic summarization has been studied for decades.

answer_2.quote: ROUGE ) is a commonly used automatic metric for summarization tasks.

answer_4.quote: we conduct a human evaluation on Amazon Mechanical Turk.
answer_4.guideline: We ask human annotators to rate the "salience" and "faithfulness" of model-generated summaries... Rate salience from 1 to 5: 1 is the worst, none of the points in the summary is important enough to be summarized; 5 is the best, all of the points mentioned in the summary are important and worth to be summarized; Rate faithfulness from 1 to 5: 1 is the worst, all of the sentences in the summary are either wrong or not existing in the email thread; 5 is the best, all of the points mentioned in the summary are true to the thread.
